usageNotes: Permanently removes an HA group configuration from the cluster. This endpoint is deprecated in favor of HA rules; prefer managing high-availability through the rules API for new configurations. Before deleting, ensure no HA resources are still assigned to the group, as removing a group with active members can disrupt service protection.
destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the HA group configuration; any HA resources still referencing this group will lose their group assignment and may fall back to default HA behavior or become unprotected.
tips: Check for HA resources still using this group via GET /cluster/ha/resources before deleting.
This API is marked deprecated — use HA rules (/cluster/ha/rules) for managing high availability in current Proxmox versions.
Returns null on success; errors if the group does not exist or if the caller lacks Sys.Console on /.
